evidence: P05-01 (BLOCKED): Settings/ActorContext/ErrorEnvelope/HealthResponse have no DATA_CONTRACTS row and no whitelisted module.

docs/architecture/issues/README.md already carries ARCH-0006 for the same class of problem.
systemic_finding.interpretation: The manifest derives a task's writable set from a file list, while the contract documents assign type ownership by task id. The two are not cross-checked, so a task can be the named owner of a boundary type with no legal place to put it. This is the fourth occurrence of the pattern (P05-01, P05-02, P05-03, plus ARCH-0006) and it is now the dominant blocker class in the repository.
systemic_finding.impact: Every future task in this phase inherits the same dead end until the two sources of truth are reconciled. Re-issuing tasks one by one cannot fix it.
systemic_finding.recommended_single_next_action: Contract owner to make one decision that (a) reconciles ARCH-0006 with the P05-01/P05-02/P05-03 boundary-type gaps, and (b) either adds the missing boundary modules to the relevant allowed_files lists or records the types as owned by a preceding task.
